vibe_rationale: Ten-year curated street-art festival with a First Nations focus and artist-led murals, narrower than SURPLUS and more public-art than social.
fit_notes: Broad public-art audience of all ages with no published demographics and weak wellness adjacency. A named sponsorships contact and paint and hire partners show brands already sit inside the culture, so a commissioning or content partnership is the realistic route, and it must be artist-led.
